After breakfast, go on a scenic ferry ride to Udo Island, known for its breathtaking scenery, natural sights and marine life. Make your way to the lighthouse on Udobong Peak, the highest spot on the island, where you will marvel at golden canola fields and stunning panoramic views of the island and its surroundings. Besides the Garden House, where you can meet the delightful Peanuts characters there is also an Outdoor Garden, which recreates scenes from the Peanuts comic strip in Jeju’s verdant nature. After which, take a relaxing stroll at Jeju Herb Dongsan, lined with 150 kinds of herbs and colourful wild flowers. Besides the enchanting scenery, you will be pampered with an aromatherapy footbath experience. Next muster up your courage while making your way across the wooden Yongyeon Bridge where you can enjoy the beautiful view of the valley.

days_detail.desc:
Welcome to Korea! Transfer to hotel in group transport. Meeting with your guide.

At the end of the afternoon, we are going to enter this fascinating country and with our guide we will go on the modern and efficient underground (we will be taught to use this public transport) to City Hall to see this building shaped like a tsunami. In front of the City Hall, we will also see the Deoksugung Palace, which is lit up at night and which allows us to appreciate the tradition and modernity of this country together. On foot, we will then go from here to the district of Myeongdong, the largest and busiest shopping area in Korea. Its name means “brilliant tunnel”. Dinner included in a local restaurant. Accommodation.

days_detail.title: Seoul
days_detail.desc: Today we include a tour of the city of Seoul lasting five hours. We will see Changdeokgung Palace. This is a World Heritage Site formed by a group of palaces inside a large park. After the visit, we will go to Bukchon Hanok Village, a traditional historical neighbourhood with tiny houses. Afterwards we will visit the War Memorial, an impressive war museum that tells of the different conflicts suffered by Korea during its history, particular the Korean War with the United Nations in which soldiers from many different countries took part. We continue to the Gangnam District, one of the busiest areas of the city, where there are numerous shopping and leisure centres. To finish, we stop at LOTTE WORLD TOWER, an impressive 550 m building where there will be time to climb the tower (entrance not included) or stroll in the park or around the luxury shopping centres. Lunch included in a local restaurant. Return to the centre and free time.

days_detail.title: Seoul – Suwon – Jeonju
days_detail.desc:
Today we include in Seoul the Gyeongbokgung Palace, an impressive palace that is 600 years old, where we will see the Changing of the Guard ceremony (if scheduled). Our next stop is the city of SUWON, former capital of Korea, a World Heritage Site famous for its walls Heritage of Mankind.
We will see the impressive wall with its fortifications and will visit Hwaseong Haenggung, the summer palace. Lunch included in a local restaurant. We continue to JEONJU, where we will see its fascinating old town (Hanok Village), with its tiny houses, traditional shops and art galleries.

days_detail.title: Jeonju – Daegu – Busan
days_detail.desc: Amidst impressive mountain forest scenery, we come to HAEINSA, a Buddhist temple built in the year 802 where we discover the Tripitaka, the most complete collection of Buddhist texts engraved on 80,000 blocks of wood. We will visit the temple and the museum on the Tripitaka. We go on to DAEGU where we see the market of traditional medicines with its different herbs, and especially ginseng, and the Museum of Oriental medicine. Lunch included. We come to BUSAN. We are in the second largest city in Korea, full of life, where is the fantastic Doosan Haeundae complex with its more than 300 m skyscraper and its sports marina. Accommodation.

days_detail.title: Busan – Seoul
days_detail.desc:
Day in BUSAN. We are going out to the city of Busan to visit HAEDONG YONGGUNG, 14th century Buddhist temple located by the sea. Return to Busan. We see the memorial to the United Nations with its cemetery were people from numerous countries are buried. We approach the largest fish market in the country, which is alongside Nampo port. Lunch included. Then we walk from there to Yongdusan park with its immense 120 m pagoda.

At around five thirty we take a modern high-speed train and in three hours we are back in SEOUL. Transfer to the hotel and accommodation.

highlights: South Korea is a dynamic and captivating country where modernity meets tradition in the most vibrant and unique ways. Known for its cutting-edge technology, bustling cities, and rich cultural heritage, South Korea offers an incredible blend of experiences. Seoul, the capital, is a thriving metropolis filled with towering skyscrapers, trendy districts like Gangnam, and historic landmarks such as Gyeongbokgung Palace, a symbol of the country’s royal past. Beyond the cities, the natural beauty of South Korea shines, with stunning mountains, serene temples, and picturesque coastlines. The food is a major highlight, with dishes like kimchi, bibimbap, and Korean BBQ offering a flavorful journey for your taste buds. The country also has a deep appreciation for art and K-pop, with a thriving music scene and vibrant festivals that showcase Korean creativity and innovation. Whether you're exploring the ancient temples, shopping in futuristic districts, or hiking through the breathtaking landscapes, South Korea promises an unforgettable adventure at every turn.

days_detail.title: Busan – Gyeongju
days_detail.desc:
Rise and shine as we kick off the day with a visit to Gyeongju the most traditional city in Korea. Gyeongju is referred to as “the museum without walls” because everywhere you turn you can find another site with historical relevance. Our first stop is to Bulguksa Temple. One of the most impressive temples in Korea and listed as an UNESCO World Heritage site since 1995. Stroll couple kilometers up (about 30 minutes) from Bulguksa Temple we will reach Seokguram Grotto. The beautiful grotto features a seated Buddha protected by twelve royal guards.

Next proceed to Hwangnidan-gil is a charming street in Gyeongju, known for its blend of traditional Korean architecture and modern boutique shops. Its picturesque ambiance, with quaint cafes and artisanal stores, offers a unique cultural experience in the heart of the Gyeongju city. Next proceed to Kyochon Village a sublime slice of bygone days and ancient style of architecture. Some of the houses have been converted into tourist shops, but many have been retained as purely residential buildings to give the place a bit more authenticity. The vast majority of the buildings have retained their traditional Korean hanok style of architecture. Thereafter, proceed to Donggung and Wolji, formerly known as Anapji Pond, is a historic site renowned for its beautifully restored palace complex and tranquil pond, offering a picturesque glimpse into Korea’s ancient royal history.

days_detail.desc: This morning enjoys a scenic ride to Gyeongju. Today, soak up some Korean history and culture at Gyeongju, ancient capital of the Silla dynasty for more than 1,000 years and also known as the museum without walls. First, see ancient Buddhist temple Bulguksa Temple, designated as a World Cultural Asset by UNESCO for its architecture and plentiful historical and cultural relics. Thereafter continue with the historical journey with a visit to the Daereungwon Tomb Complex. The large ancient tombs of kings and nobles of the Silla Kingdom can be seen. Next proceed to Gyochon Traditional Village, a historic village that preserves the traditional lifestyle and cultural heritage of the Silla Dynasty, featuring well-preserved hanok houses and local crafts. Continue to Woljeonggyo Bridge, a beautifully reconstructed wooden bridge that once served as a major gateway to the royal palace during the Unified Silla period, offering picturesque views and a glimpse into Korea’s rich history.

Next enjoy a tranquil scenic stroll through the historical Woljeongsa Temple and the peaceful needle fir forest road.

days_detail.title: Incheon – Seoul – Mokpo
days_detail.desc: Upon arrival in Seoul, start your day with a tour to the majestic Gyeongbok Palace, the palace during the Joseon dynasty. Roam its stately grounds, delve into its storied past and imagine what it might have been like centuries ago. Thereafter, proceed to Ikseon-dong hanok village, Korea cutest neighbourhood with little alleys filled with Hanoks, amazing cafes and great restaurants. Afternoon, enjoy the popular Pork Knuckle set at Manjokohyang, a Michelin Guide-recognized restaurant famous for its tender, flavourful pork knuckle, offering a premium dining experience with traditional Korean flavours. After a delicious lunch, sit back and unwind as you travel to Mokpo aboard the KTX high-speed train. This evening, as we head south, savour Namdo Hanjeongsik, a traditional Korean set meal from the Namdo region, featuring a variety of fresh, flavourful dishes for an authentic culinary experience. End the day with an enthralling display of light, sound and water at Dancing Sea Fountain.

days_detail.desc: This morning, visit the scenic Wando-gun in Jeollanam-do, famous for its abalone. Get a first-hand experience in abalone harvesting and tasting session. Thereafter, continue to Wando Marine Healing Centre where you can experience a rejuvenating seaweed foam baths and mud therapy, that provides relaxation and natural wellness treatments by the sea. Next, enjoy a relaxing monorail ride to the impressive Wando Tower standing 76 metres tall, overlooking several islands. In addition to exploring local flavours, and with Haenam known as a key sweet potato growing region, you will enjoy a memorable culinary moment through the Haenam DIY Sweet Potato Bread Making experience, where you get hands-on crafting your very own sweet potato bread.

Mokpo – Jeungdo Island – Jeonju

(Breakfast/ Octopus Set Lunch/ Salt Ice-cream snack/ \Bibimbap with Pajeon and Makgeolli Dinner\)

This morning, explore tranquil Jeungdo Island, which is the 1st city to be designated a slow city in Asia, by virtue of its unspoiled natural landscape and clean, pristine waters. Get back to basics with a visit to Taepyeong Salt Farm, Korea’s largest single salt farm. Experience the fun of Salt Harvesting and enjoy a cup of savoury salt ice-cream. Thereafter, enjoy a relaxing Salt Therapy at Salt Cave Healing Centre. Next, proceed to Jeonju Hanok Village and wrap up the day with a deeper appreciation of Korean culture. Beyond its rich heritage, Jeonju is also famous for its handmade Choco Pies dating back to 1951, so get ready to create your very own Choco Pie. End the evening by dining like a local with classic Korean Bibimbap, Pajeon, and Makgeolli.

Note:

For travel between 01November – 30November, Salt Harvesting and savoury salt ice-cream will be replaced with DIY Salt Ball making.

days_detail.title: Jeonju – Gunsan – Yongin – Seoul
days_detail.desc: This morning, we will visit a Gunsan Gyeongam-dong Railroad Village, a must-visit place when Koreans come to Gunsan. On first glance, resembles any other older neighbourhood in Korea until you notice the pair of train tracks that cuts straight through the middle of the village. In the past, trains from the Paper Korea factory- a factory that made paper used for print news- would cross through Gyeongamdong on these tracks carrying loads of supplies and finished products. Though the trains are now a part of history, the humble neighbourhood and visitors can now walk along the 2.5km railway tracks, passing by the old homes that have sat here for decades. Here, you will also get to make your own Dalgona, Korea’s nostalgic honeycomb candy, just like the ones crafted at traditional street stalls. Here in Gunsan, don’t forget to try out the famous Bread from Lee Sung Dang Bakery, the oldest bakery in Korea. Next embark on a search for the freshest seasonal fruits as we bring you to source in Yongin. Here at the local fruit farm, you can get to hand pick some of Korea seasonal fruits. Thereafter, enjoy a relaxing scenic coach ride back to Seoul. Tonight, you will indulge in a sumptuous feast of fresh Korean lobster and a rich, flavourful seafood hotpot.

Arrive at Jeju International Airport in the morning and begin your Jeju adventure. Visit Hyeopjae Beach, famous for its crystal-clear turquoise waters, white sandy shores and scenic views of Biyangdo Island. days_detail.title: Jeju
days_detail.desc:
Take a morning excursion to Udo Island, a charming offshore island known for its beautiful coastal scenery. Visit Udobong Peak for panoramic views, Seobin Baeksa, famous for its distinctive white coral beach, and Geommeolle Beach, a scenic black-sand beach surrounded by dramatic cliffs. Continue to Seongsan Ilchulbong (Sunrise Peak), a UNESCO World Heritage Site renowned for its volcanic crater and spectacular coastal views. Visit Herb Dongsan for a relaxing stroll through its fragrant herb garden, including an indoor foot spa experience.

Next, head to Mureung Farm to experience Jeju's famous citrus harvest through an enjoyable DIY Tangerine Jam Making Experience, where you'll prepare your own homemade jam using fresh local tangerines.



Note

 In the event of unfavourable weather conditions, Udo Island will be replaced with Seopjikoji and Arte Museum.

days_detail.desc: Start the day with a visit to Snoopy Garden, a charming attraction featuring Snoopy and Peanuts-themed gardens and displays. Enjoy a fun Horse Riding Experience, followed by a visit to Jeju Donghwa Village, an enchanting attraction featuring creative themed spaces and a Studio Ghibli exhibition. Continue to the tranquil Secret Forest, where you can immerse yourself in Jeju’s lush natural surroundings. In the evening, enjoy the energetic NANTA Show, a popular non-verbal performance combining comedy, music, cooking and dynamic drumming.

days_detail.desc: Begin the day at Seogwipo Healing Forest, where you can enjoy a peaceful walk surrounded by Jeju’s lush greenery and natural beauty. Continue to Seogwipo Maeil Olle Market, a lively traditional market where you can explore local delicacies and Jeju specialties. Visit Jusangjeolli Cliff, renowned for its spectacular hexagonal volcanic rock formations along the coastline, before proceeding to Camellia Hill, a beautifully landscaped botanical garden featuring colourful camellias and seasonal flowers.

days_detail.desc: Visit a Ginseng Showroom to learn more about Korea’s renowned ginseng products, followed by a stop at a Cosmetic Shop featuring popular Korean beauty and skincare products. Continue to Osulloc Tea Museum & Innisfree House, where you can discover Korea’s tea culture while enjoying the beautiful green tea fields of Jeju. Explore Sanang Keuneonggot and proceed to Vicheollin Theme Park, where you can enjoy a variety of activities including a kayak experience, beautifully landscaped gardens, the unique Gotjawal forest and a fun maze park. End the day with leisure and shopping time at Nuwemaru Shopping Street, one of Jeju’s popular shopping and dining areas.
